text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm passing by the training
course...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Just, um... forget you saw anything,
okay? I'm
sure you don't want to
remember that anyway.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, maybe I can sing in tune, but
that's not
the same thing as being a
good singer.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
My grandmother would always say that a
concert
is an opportunity to give thanks.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Even if you sing well, it doesn't matter if
your
heart's not into it.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I think that's just how much she
loved the
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
She was actually one of the founding
members
who fought to get the Grand
Concert off the
ground. That's what I
heard from my mother,
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Apparently. I never knew until I started

researching the concert—you can
imagine my
surprise.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I wish I could introduce her to the
person I
told you about...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry! Look at me rambling about
myself.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I will say, though... From what I've heard
so far, I
really do think
<chrname> is a good
singer.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
So when it comes time for her to stand
on stage, I
hope you'll pay close
attention.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Because I think her song will be filled
with
gratitude for the person who's
always stood by
her side.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I get the chance to
observe
<chrname> at one of
her dance
lessons.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her singing seems to ooze with emotion.
